title: On our boat, the day starts with good morning, then something lies down on the towpath
description:
I live on a long boat on a quiet canal with my old dog, Moss. For twelve years our mornings went the same way. This summer her legs got slow, and she stopped coming up the steps.

Now, at dawn in the autumn fog, something lies in the grass beside the water. It's as long as my boat, and every morning it's one mooring ring nearer.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Did you spot the patch of grass by the back ring before the long one got there?
